document_proposals.uncertainty_basis: Quoted battery specification; pack condition is not measured.

causal_path: Forecast wind and payload mass raise route power demand.
Integrated route energy consumes the usable pack energy.
The landing reserve may fall below the declared fraction.

supporting_references.summary: Battery specification states 180 Wh usable energy.
Catalog mechanism for route energy demand.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: Forecast wind is not a route-local measurement and the pack energy is a nameplate value.

confirm_if.description: Landing reserve falls below the declared fraction.

falsify_if.description: Remaining energy exceeds the reserve at landing.

summary.label: NOT A READINESS VERDICT
limitations: This evidence-bound summary is not a deployment readiness verdict.
Results are limited to executed providers and nominal conditions.
